stock.description: Headquartered in Guangzhou, China, Fangzhou Inc. delivers comprehensive online chronic disease management services throughout the nation. The company leverages its dedicated digital platform to assist individuals grappling with long-term health issues like hypertension, cardiovascular, and respiratory conditions. Its mobile application facilitates a suite of "H2H" services, comprising virtual medical consultations, e-prescribing, and prescription renewal options. Furthermore, Fangzhou provides healthcare products through an online retail pharmacy and manages its own network of hospitals and brick-and-mortar pharmacies. The company was established in 2015.
